origin.claim: The spread between two expiries of the same commodity is a financing/storage carry; when its annualised value exceeds the exchange-published round-trip cost, the carry is capturable.

rules.entry: Annualised calendar spread >= 12% after measured round-trip fees.
rules.exit: Exit when the annualised spread compresses below 4%, or when either contract is within 5 days of expiry.
rules.sizing: Target notional per leg, capped by both contracts published liquidity.

thesis: Buy the near expiry and sell the far expiry (or the reverse) whenever the annualised spread between the official mid prices exceeds the exchange published round-trip fee converted at the official USD/RUB rate. Both legs are real orders with real fees.
what_it_means: 6 ledger records so far: 6 distinct commodity exposures across moex_forts.
